description: Namur - Voiries entretenues - Proportion is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Historique du nombre de voiries 'dites' entretenues. C'est à dire ayant subie des travaux d'entretien dans l'année données ou durant les années précédentes (selon sa périodicité d'entretien pour usure). Responsables des données: Département des Voies Publiques - DVP / Service Technique Voirie Et l'application " Voiries en ligne ". Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Urban planning, Heritage. Its keywords are Voirie, entretien, travaux, Rue. The portal shows 41 records. The portal shows 2023-10-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
